content: Bɛɛsɑsɑɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikuu sɔɔrɑ Dɑniɛli u dosɑ. U kɑ̃siru wɑ sɑɑ ye u kpĩ win kpin yerɔ. Yen biru, u yoruɑ ye n weenɛ tɔmbu bu ɡiɑ dosu ɡe sɔɔ.
U ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, ye nɑ wɑ kɑ̃si te sɔɔ wɔ̃kuru wee. Nɑ woo ɡɑɡu wɑ ɡɑ nɑ wɔllun beri berikɑ nnɛn di ɡɑ nim wɔ̃ku bɔkɔn nim so.
Yerɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ bɛkɛ nnɛ yi yɑrimɑ nim wɔ̃ku ɡen min di, yen ɡɑɑ kun kɑ ɡɑɑ weenɛ.
Ye nɑ ɡbiɑ nɑ wɑ yɑ kɑ ɡbee sunɔ weenɛ mɑ yɑ ɡunɔ bɑkerun kɑsɑ mɔ. Ye nɑ mɑɑ mɛɛrɑ, yerɑ nɑ wɑ bɑ kɑsɑ ye wunɑ. Mɑ bɑ yen tii seeyɑ bɑ yɔ̃rɑsiɑ nɡe tɔnu. Mɑ bɑ ye tɔnun bwisikunu dokeɑ.
Yen yiruse yɑ kɑ yɑɑ ɡɔbɑ weenɛ mɑ yɑ kɑ yɛ̃si tiɑ yɔ̃. Yɛ̃sɑn kukunu itɑwɑ yɑ nɔɔ bɛri. Mɑ bɑ ye sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yu seewo yu yɑɑ mwɛ.
Yen biru, nɑ itɑse wɑ yɑ kɑ musuku ɡbeeku weenɛ mɑ yɑ kɑsɑ nnɛ mɔ yen biru wɔllɔ. Mɑ yɑ winu nnɛ mɔ. Bɑ ye yiiko wɛ̃ yu kɑ bɑndu di.

Yenibɑn biru, yerɑ nɑ yɑɑ nnɛse wɑ nɛn kɑ̃si te sɔɔ. Yɑɑ ye, yɑ nɑnum mɔ. Yɑ mɑɑ dɑm mɔ too. Mɑ yɑ don sisuɡii bɑkɑnu mɔ. Yɑ̀ n yɑɑ mwɑ, yɑ rɑ yɑɑ yen kukunu kɔsukuwɑ kpɑ yu di. Ye yɑ tiɑrɑ kpɑ yu tɑɑku tɑɑku. Yɑɑ ye, yɑ ǹ kɑ yɛɛ ɡbiikii yi weenɛ. Kɔbi wɔkurɑ yɑ mɔ.

Ye nɑ kɔbi yi mɛɛrɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ, yerɑ nɑ kɔbu piibu ɡɑɡu wɑ ɡɑ yɑrimɑ yen wirun di ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ yiɔnɔn suunu sɔɔ. Kɔbu piibu ɡe, ɡɑ kɔbi wɔku ten itɑ wukɑ. Gɑ nɔni mɔ nɡe tɔnu, ɡɑ mɑɑ nɔɔ mɔ ɡɑ ɡɑri mɔ̀ kɑ tii suɑbu.
Gusunɔn siribu

Ye nɑ mɛɛrɑ tii, yerɑ nɑ wɑ bɑ sinɑ kitɑru yiimɔ. Mɑ nɑ ɡoo wɑ nɡe durɔ tɔkɔ u nɑ u sinɑ win sinɑ kitɑru sɔɔ. Yɑ̃ɑ kpikinu fɑrɑ fɑrɑwɑ u doke. Mɑ win seri yi buriri fem fem. Win sinɑ kitɑ te, tɑ bɑllimɔwɑ nɡe dɔ̃ɔ yɑri bɑkɑru. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ ten nɑɑsun tii.

Mɑ dɔ̃ɔ yɑri bɑkɑru tɑ yɑrimɔ win sinɑ kitɑ ten min di tɑ kokumɔ nɡe nim. Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑ nɔrɔm nɔrɔm bɑ nɑ bɑ nùn sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Mɑ ben ɡɑbu bɑ yɔ̃ win wuswɑɑɔ. Siri kowobu bɑ nɑ bɑ sinɑ. Mɑ bɑ tirenu wukiɑ.
Ye nɑ kɔbu piibu ɡe mɛɛrɑ ɡɑ tii suɑ ɡɑri ɡerumɔ, yerɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ yɑɑ ye ɡo, bɑ ye suɑ bɑ kpɛ̃ɛ dɔ̃ɔ boko sɔɔ.
Gbeeku yɛɛ yi yi tie, bɑ yin dɑm wɔrɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ derɑ yi wɑ̃ɑ sere sɑɑ ɡɑɑ.
Wɔ̃ku te, kɑ̃si te sɔɔ, ye nɑ mɑɑ wɑ wee. Nɑ ɡoo wɑ u sɑrɑmɑ wɔllun di ɡuru wii wuroru sɔɔ. Mɑ u dɑ durɔ tɔkɔ win mi ɡiɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn susisiɑ win wuswɑɑɔ.
Bɑ nùn bɑndu kɑ bɛɛrɛ kɑ yiiko wɛ̃. Mɑ bɑ nùn ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro nɔmu sɔndiɑ. Bwesenu kpuro nu nùn sɑ̃wɑ. Win bɑndɑ kun nɔru mɔ. Tɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Kɑ̃sinun tubusiɑnu
Nɛ Dɑniɛli nɛn bwɛ̃rɑ kun kpunɛ domi kɑ̃si ni nɑ wɑ mi, nu mɑn nɑndɑ.
Yerɑ nɑ ɡɔrɑdo ben turo susi be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi. Mɑ nɑ nùn bikiɑ nɑ nɛɛ, mbɑ ɡɑri yi kpuron tubusiɑnu. U mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɡbeeku yɛɛ bɛkɛ nnɛ ye, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ sinɑmbu nnɛ be bɑ koo bɑndu di di duniɑ sɔɔ.
Yen biru, Wɔrukoo u koo de win tɔn dɛɛrobu bu bɑndu mwɑ bɑ n dii sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.

Kɑ mɛ, nɑ kɑsu n ɡbeeku yɑɑ nnɛse ye yɑ ǹ kɑ itɑ yeɔnɔ weenɛ min tubusiɑnu ɡiɑ dee dee. Domi yɑɑ ye, yɑ nɑnum mɔ too. Yen donnu nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ sisu mɑ yen nikisu su sɑ̃ɑ sii ɡɑndu. Yɑ̀ n yɑɑ mwɑ yɑ rɑ yen kukunu kɔsukuwɑ kpɑ yu di. Yen ye yɑ tiɑrɑ kpɑ yu tɑɑku tɑɑku.

Nɑ mɑɑ kɑsu n kɔbi wɔku ten tubusiɑnu ɡiɑ te yɑ mɔ yen wirɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ kɔbu piibu ɡe ɡɑ yɑrimɑ yen wirun di ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ yiɔnɔn suunu sɔɔ. Kɔbi wɔku ten itɑ yɑ wɔrukɑ yen wuswɑɑɔ. Gɑ nɔni mɔ, ɡɑ nɔɔ mɔ, mɑ ɡɑ ɡɑri mɔ̀ kɑ tii suɑbu, ɡɑ mɑɑ nɑnum mɔ ɡɑ yiɔnɔ kere.
Mɑ nɑ kɔbu piibu ɡe wɑ ɡɑ kɑ Wɔrukoon tɔn dɛɛrobu tɑbu mɔ̀ ɡɑ bu kɑmiɑmɔ.
Adɑmɑ durɔ tɔkɔ wi, u nɑ u Gusunɔn tɔn be ɡem wɛ̃. Sɑnɑm mɛ sɑɑ yɑ turɑ mɑ bɑ bɑndu di.
Mɑ durɔ wi, u mɑn tubusiɑ u nɛɛ, yɑɑ nnɛse ye, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɑndu nnɛse te bɑ koo swĩi hɑnduniɑ yeni sɔɔ. Bɑn te, tɑ ǹ kɑ ɡɑru weenɛ. Tɑ koo hɑnduniɑ kpuro ɡo tu tɑɑku tu muniɑ muku muku.
Kɔbi wɔku te, tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ sinɑmbu wɔkuru be bɑ koo bɑn te di. Yen biru, sunɔ ɡoo wi u ǹ kɑ ben ɡoo weenɛ u koo sinɑmbu wɔku ten itɑ bɑndu yɑrɑ kpɑ u bɑndu di.
Sunɔ wi, u koo Wɔrukoo ɡɑri kɑm ɡerusi kpɑ u win tɔn dɛɛrobu nɔni sɔ̃. U ko n mɑɑ kĩ u sɑɑbɑ kɑ woodɑbɑ kɔsi. Bɑ koo nùn tɔn dɛɛrobu nɔmu sɔndiɑ sere sɑɑ itɑ kɑ bɔnu.
Yen biru, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo sunɔ wi siri, kpɑ u nùn bɑndu yɑrɑ mɑm mɑm sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Yen biru, bɑ koo bɑn ni nu wɑ̃ɑ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ kpuron dɑm kɑ nin yiiko Wɔrukoon tɔn dɛɛrobu nɔmu bɛriɑ. Win bɑndu tɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Wiyɑ sinɑmbu kpuro bɑ koo sɑ̃ kpɑ bu nùn mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
Ye nɛ Dɑniɛli nɑ wɑ yerɑ mi. Ye nɑ ye bwisikɑ, nɑ nɑndɑ mɑ nɛn wuswɑɑ burisinɑ. Adɑmɑ nɑ ye kpuro beruɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Dɑniɛli u yɑ̃ɑ kinɛru
kɑ boo wɑ kɑ̃siru sɔɔ
